```cs
using System;
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using BenchmarkDotNet.Attributes;
using BenchmarkDotNet.Godot.Attributes;
using BenchmarkDotNet.Godot.Attributes.Jobs;
using Godot;

[MemoryDiagnoser]
[GodotSimpleJob]
public partial class PoolTest : Node2D
{
    [Params(50_000)]
    public int Count { get; set; }

    StringName cached_sn = new("my_group");
    Vector2[] polygon = [new(0, 2), new(1.732f, 1), new(1.732f, -1), new(0, -2), new(-1.732f, -1), new(-1.732f, 1)];

    public void RunGetNodesInGroup(int count, bool usePool)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            var arr = GetTree().GetNodesInGroup(cached_sn);
            if (usePool) Pools.ArrayPool<Node>.Instance.Return(arr);
        }
    }

    [GodotBenchmark]
    public void GetNodesInGroup_Base()
    {
        RunGetNodesInGroup(Count, false);
    }

    [GodotBenchmark]
    public void GetNodesInGroup_ReturnToPool()
    {
        RunGetNodesInGroup(Count, true);
    }

    [GodotBenchmark]
    public void OffsetPolygon_Base()
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
        {
            var res = Geometry2D.OffsetPolygon(polygon, 10, Geometry2D.PolyJoinType.Round);
        }
    }

    [GodotBenchmark]
    public void OffsetPolygon_ReturnToPool()
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
        {
            var res = Geometry2D.OffsetPolygon(polygon, 10, Geometry2D.PolyJoinType.Round);
            Pools.ArrayPool<Vector2[]>.Instance.Return(res);
        }
    }

    [GodotBenchmark]
    public void GetDatetimeDictFromSystem_Base()
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
        {
            Time.GetDatetimeDictFromSystem(true);
        }
    }

    [GodotBenchmark]
    public void GetDatetimeDictFromSystem_ReturnToPool()
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
        {
            var res = Time.GetDatetimeDictFromSystem(true);
            Pools.DictionaryPoolInstance.Return(res);
        }
    }
}

```
